newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Leading Kuwaiti MP wounded in armed attack - official.
newsitem.headline: Leading Kuwaiti MP wounded in armed attack - official.

text.p: A leading liberal Kuwaiti parliamentarian was shot twice in an assassination attempt on Friday, the interior ministry said.
Abdullah al-Naibari, 61, was rushed to a hospital with two bullet wounds in his jaw and shoulder along with his wife Feryal who was injured in her shoulder, a ministry spokesman said.
"Al-Naibari is in intensive care and so is his wife. Their doctors informed us that his condition is quite stable," the spokesman told reporters at the hospital in Adan, south of Kuwait City.
He strongly condemned the attempt and vowed that the ministry would move swiftly to arrest the attackers.
Al-Naibari, a leading government critic who has also opposed some Islamist bills in parliament, was driving home from his beachhouse close to the southern border with Saudi Arabia when attacked.
